ExtlIntrIdMapping.name: ExtlIntrIdMapping
ExtlIntrIdMapping.description: Represents a mapping between a Salesforce record and its corresponding record in an external system, such as Workday.

ExternalIdentifier.description: The ID of the external event.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the record was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the record was last viewed.

Name.description: The name of the external event’s organizer.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the creator of the external event.

RecordIdentifier.description: The ID of the Salesforce record that is linked to a record in an external system.

RelatedExternalIdentifier.description: The ID of an associated record from the external system that provides additional context for the integration.
